{{Quote|Captain Sait has a contact in the Black Sun who is willing to take this ship off our hands for a good sum of credits. You'll make more than you would in a lifetime of service to the Empire. All you have to do is stay quiet and go along for the ride|Kenkirk to [[Olum]]|<ref name="Sony">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67578&month=012008|text=Friday Feature &ndash; Sait's Rebellion}}</ref>}}
'''Kenkirk''' was a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] and [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] who lived at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
[[File:Commander_Kenkirk_VT-49.png|thumb|left|250px|At one point, Kenkirk was in command of a [[VT-49 Decimator/Legends|VT-49 Decimator]]]]
Kenkirk entered the Imperial Navy and rose to the rank of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]]. As of [[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 ABY]] he served aboard the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyer]] [[Blackguard (Star Destroyer)|''Blackguard'']] under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Andal Sait]]. When Sait decided to go rogue and sell his ship to the criminal [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate, Kenkirk too became a traitor to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] and remained loyal to Sait. He helped test other officers' allegiance and persuaded several of his fellow crew members to follow the traitorous Captain.

Kenkirk was on duty on the ''Blackguard's'' bridge when chief engineer [[Olum]] started all the ship's [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]] to use them to transmit a message to the Empire, warning them about Sait's treachery. As Olum had disabled the ship's [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beams]], most of the fighters were shot down. After this incident, Sait promoted Kenkirk to the rank of Commander.

Eventually the news about Sait's treachery got out and a crew of heavily armed [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] was sent to the ''Blackguard''. The spacers boarded the ship and managed to [[Retaking of the Blackguard|fight]] their way through the ship towards the Star Destroyer's bridge. Kenkirk awaited them not far from the bridge and attacked the adventurers with heavy weapons, but was killed in the fight. Soon after, Sait was killed too and the spacers gained control of the ''Blackguard''.

==Behind the scenes==
Cmdr. Kenkirk was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:SD" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Kenkirk was added to the game as part of the [[W:c:swg:Lost Star Destroyer|"Star Destroyer" Heroic Encounter]],<ref name="SWG:SD" /> introduced with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Chapter 8 Notes for Jan 15 2008|"Chapter 8" update]], on [[January 15]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 8: The Nova Orion Crisis">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67563&month=012008|text=Chapter 8: The Nova Orion Crisis}}</ref> Kenkirk was the penultimate boss for the player groups who tried to beat the rogue Imperials and regain control of the Star Destroyer ''Blackguard''.<ref name="SWG:SD" />
